sourceDocuments.title: Fiscal Federalism and Mineral Resource Revenue Sharing
sourceDocuments.text: Derivation principles in intergovernmental revenue allocation formulas attempt to compensate mineral-bearing littoral communities for environmental degradation and natural capital depletion.

studentDocument.title: Returns to Higher Education and Graduate Unemployment in Lagos
studentDocument.text: Human capital rate-of-return analyses indicate that university graduates encounter prolonged frictional job search durations in white-collar formal employment, driving youth labor market absorption into gig economy fintech services.
